children: Palo Alto Networks Inc reported fiscal 2026 revenue of $11.48B, up 24.5% from $9.22B a year earlier, while net income declined to $307M and diluted EPS fell to $0.4— according to its 10-K for the year.
¹ Reported as “Total revenue”. ² Reported as “Net income”. ³ Reported as “income per share, diluted”.
Revenue growth was driven by subscription expansion and recent acquisitions, increasing recurring revenue and lifting total revenue to $11.5B.
Subscriptions accounted for roughly 80% of revenue as the company continued a two-tier indirect channel model and shifted toward recurring cloud services.
Product and platform momentum included launches and updates such as Prisma AIRS, PAN-OS 12.1, expanded Cortex offerings, and Chronosphere observability, with integrations of recent acquisitions.

Management increased investments in R&D and sales, expanded global reach to serve customers in 180+ countries, and raised cloud and AI security spending to support Cortex, Prisma AIRS, AI agents security, and observability at scale.
